verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents its own caching control, `caching: 'auto'` in providerOptions.gateway, which applies a provider-appropriate caching strategy. Community discussion of Vercel cache-read pricing suggests this is provider-side prompt caching that cuts cost on repeated prompts. That covers part of the story but is not clearly gateway-level response caching. missing for 10: explicit gateway-side response caching of full outputs, TTL/cache-key configuration, documented latency benefits, cache hit observability, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache responses at the gateway to cut cost and latency on repeated requests

citations.quote: You can use `caching: 'auto'` in `providerOptions.gateway` to let AI Gateway automatically apply the appropriate caching strategy based on the provider.
Vercel cache read pricing for DeepSeek-v4: $0.01/M for flash, $0.14/M for pro
